payload.title: Choose a color theme and mode in Settings
payload.description:
As the student, I want to pick cool, warm or neutral colors and force light or dark in Settings.

Feature: Appearance settings
  Scenario: Switch to the warm theme
    Given the Settings dialog is open
    When I choose the Warm theme
    Then the whole interface, the editor and the terminal use the warm palette
  Scenario: Force dark mode
    Given the system prefers light
    When I choose Dark in Settings
    Then the interface uses the dark palette
  Scenario: No obvious toggle
    Given the IDE main screen
    Then there is no light/dark toggle outside Settings
